headline: 🆕 A SHOWING FOR SUNDAY AT 12:30 WAS CONFIRMED BY YOUR SELLER BY TEXT AT MIDDAY — 225 Willow Point, three addresses on the tour — AND IT IS NOT BOOKED ANYWHERE. ⚠️ That is the whole risk: a showing agreed by text that never reaches the scheduler is the one that gets missed, and it would be this listing's first tour since it went live Wednesday. ⭐ Otherwise the feed has been silent since Thursday lunchtime — no new tour, no new form in twenty hours — so the four open reads on this board are all still yours to answer, led by the buyer's agent at 1709 Fieldstone who owes you an answer on the roof report TODAY.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE BUYER'S AGENT ASKED YOU TO PICK UP AND NOBODY HAS — and this morning your own seller receipted it. Robert B. texted “let me know when you have a second” at 4:14 PM Wednesday, eight minutes after writing that he would speak with his buyers about the signed inspection addendum and roof report. ⭐ AT 11:25 TODAY YOUR SELLER ASKED WHETHER THE BUYERS HAD SAID ANYTHING — which independently confirms the answer is still owed, and that it is owed TODAY.
hotSignals.action: Call Robert B. today and collect the answer on the roof report — the call is two days overdue and your seller asked about it herself this morning. While you have him, settle the open appraisal status with the lender.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 STILL THE BEST BUYER READ ON THE BOARD AND NOW ON DAY SIX. Amy G. of Ethos International filed interested — YES and wrote that her buyers have just started looking, really like the property, and have put it at the TOP of their list. ⭐ SHE LEFT “PRICED RIGHT” BLANK — the fifth consecutive read since the cut to decline the price question entirely. 🔴 AND SHE REPORTED THE BASEMENT LIGHTS WOULD NOT COME ON, which nobody has confirmed either way.
hotSignals.action: Call her, don't write. Answer the basement lights first — buyers who have just started looking are touring other homes this week with a dark basement as their last memory of yours. Then ask the question her blank price field invites: what would it take.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 NOT A SHOWINGTIME FORM — THE BUYER HIMSELF, BY TEXT. Adin D. named his gap under the ask, told you to save his number as a standing investor, and added “Happy to have you represent me.” Two days on, both of his questions — is there room, and will you represent me — are still unanswered.
hotSignals.action: One call does both jobs. And his number is now the best-supported figure on this house: Thursday's form made it four independent reads calling the price too high.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE STRONGEST SINGLE WORD ANY AGENT HAS FILED ON THIS BOARD, AND IT IS TWELVE DAYS OLD. Wanda W. of Millennium Homes answered the interest question with the single word “Very” and left every other field blank. Two other agents toured the same weekend and both passed on SIZE, not price — verified three ways.
hotSignals.action: Call her. It is a team listing rather than yours, which is exactly why it keeps sliding — and exactly why one call would be unusual enough to matter. Do not read the two passes as a price signal; the objection is square footage.

upcoming: 🆕 SUN 8/23 12:30 PM — 225 WILLOW POINT CIR. ⚠️ CONFIRMED BY YOUR SELLER BY TEXT AT MIDDAY TODAY AND NOT BOOKED ANYWHERE — no ShowingTime request, no confirmation in the feed, and the board had it recorded the other way two hours earlier. ⭐ IT WOULD BE THIS LISTING'S FIRST TOUR since it went live Wednesday, and the agent is taking three addresses in one run. ⛔ Get it into the scheduler; a text-only showing is the one that gets missed.

📭 NOTHING ELSE IS BOOKED ANYWHERE ON THE SHOWING CALENDAR — not one other confirmed future showing, walk-through, inspection or appraisal in the feed. The last tour of any kind was Thursday lunchtime at 2368 Ridge Trail, and that one has already filed its form. ⚠️ Six active listings are carrying no forward date at all.

⏰ THU 8/28 — 195 LAKE VIEW CIR closes, and that date MOVED UP this morning. 🔴 The engine caught at 11:05 that the brokerage's commission disbursement authorisation had been read as a lender clear-to-close — it is not one — and that the 8/31 date this board carried is superseded by title's 8/28. ⭐ SEVEN DAYS, NOT TEN. Three items are open — survey, home warranty and septic — and the title side has not replied in-thread since 8/20. Septic has lead time, which is what turns a paperwork list into a date risk.

📅 SAT 8/30 — 833 MADISON LN goes live. Nothing is booked because it is not on the market yet. ⭐ The Willow Point lesson applies: the gap that costs you is between “photos ready” and “live,” so 8/30 is the date to protect.
📆 MON 9/14 — 3350 ALTAMONT RD E21 closes. All three gates are essentially behind it; the only quiet item is the inspection paperwork sitting with your seller since 8/17, now five days.
📆 FRI 10/23 — 1709 FIELDSTONE CIR closes. Longest runway on the board, which makes this the cheapest week to settle the open appraisal question rather than the most expensive one.
